The PKGBUILD contains no executable code in global scope. The plasmazones.install script performs routine KDE cache refresh operations (sycoca, icons, desktop files) and manages a systemd user service - all expected for a KDE Plasma extension. The kbuildsycoca.hook is a standard pacman hook triggering cache rebuilds on KCM plugin changes. The plasmazones-refresh-sycoca script uses standard Linux commands (pgrep, ps, su, kbuildsycoca6) to refresh KDE caches for active sessions. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit kbuildsycoca.hook and plasmazones.install due to HTTP 400 API errors, leaving critical install-time scripts unreviewed
learnings: API errors (HTTP 400, timeouts) should not force an inconclusive verdict when another model has successfully reviewed the same files - the tool should recognize tool failures vs security concerns
When multiple models audit the same package, a verdict should be determined by successful analyses rather than being blocked by transient API failures in one model
The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient API errors before marking files as inconclusive
